groups.sentence: Instructors tell students at the start of the course, such as in the syllabus, whether and how they use generative AI.
Instructors must disclose their use of AI in course preparation, delivery, grading or content to students.
Instructors' own AI use is described to students, such as in syllabus statements, examples or notices.
Instructors disclose any use of AI detection tools to students, in advance and in the syllabus or assignment directions.
Instructors will not use generative AI for teaching, grading or evaluating student work, or upload student work to AI tools.
Instructors get student permission or let students opt out before putting their work into AI tools or public databases.
Instructors are transparent about their own use of generative AI and disclose it to students.
Instructor transparency about AI use builds trust and reinforces shared norms, and faculty and students are held to the same standard.
